question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
data_with_stats AS (
  SELECT v.*, s.avg_loss_rate, s.std_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ANY_VALUE(avg_loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < avg_loss_rate - std_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_1_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= avg_loss_rate - std_loss_rate AND "loss_rate_%" <= avg_loss_rate + std_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_1_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > avg_loss_rate + std_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_1_stddev
FROM data_with_stats

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
data_with_stats AS (
  SELECT v.*, s.avg_loss_rate, s.std_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ANY_VALUE(avg_loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < avg_loss_rate - std_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_1_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= avg_loss_rate - std_loss_rate AND "loss_rate_%" <= avg_loss_rate + std_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_1_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > avg_loss_rate + std_loss_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_1_stddev
FROM data_with_stats
